NEW SECTION . 100B.51 Length of service award 4 programs —— authorization. 5 The governing body of a municipality, as defined in section 6 100B.21, is authorized to establish a length of service award 7 program for volunteer fire fighters as defined in section 8 85.61, emergency medical care providers as defined in section 9 147A.1 who are volunteers, and reserve peace officers as 10 defined in section 80D.1A. The program shall provide length 11 of service awards, as described in section 457(e)(11) of the 12 Internal Revenue Code, to volunteer fire fighters, volunteer 13 emergency medical care providers, and reserve peace officers 14 serving a municipality that elects to establish a program. The 15 program shall be designed to treat awards from the program as 16 a tax-deferred benefit under the Internal Revenue Code. The 17 governing body of the municipality shall, in consultation with 18 the chief or other person in command of the fire department 19 and police department serving the municipality, as applicable, 20 adopt guidelines providing for eligibility requirements for 21 participation by volunteer fire fighters, volunteer emergency 22 medical care providers, and reserve peace officers, minimum 23 vesting requirements, distribution requirements, and such other 24 guidelines as deemed necessary to operate the program. 25 Sec. 2.
